observations.statement: Run best unchanged: Round 3 best (INGV 2.2863) < Round 2 best (INGA 2.8315); all 24 R3 assays <= 2.2863. 21 distinct single mutants of INGA have now been measured (positions 40/41/54 nearly swept), none exceeded 2.2863.

pos54 sweep on ING* backbone: V 2.2863 > S 1.7221 > T 1.7185 > L 0.8198 > G 0.7857 > Q 0.2151 > D 0.0979 > P 0.0185 > K 0.0035 > R 0.0036; parent A54 = 2.8315 best. Y/F/I/M unmeasured (Y54 is the WT residue).
pos40 sweep on I*GA backbone: N 2.8315 > K 2.0137 > V 1.9130 > E 0.6130 > P 0.5096. K/V tolerated near 2.0; E/P poor.
pos41 sweep on IN*A backbone (8 substitutions measured in Round 3): L 1.0353 > N 0.6426 > Y 0.4085 > T 0.0708 > V 0.0456 > R 0.0198 > E 0.0023 > Q 0.0016; G41 parent strongly preferred.

Zero measured double mutants across the whole run. Plateau combinations IKGV/IVGV exist only as surrogate predictions (1.946/1.907) exceeding linear and log-additive expectations from noisy single-mutant values.
EXPLORE_UNCERTAIN was low-yield: mean 0.300, best INNA 0.6426 (pos41 N). Surrogate uncertainty extremes (INQV/INEV/INVV) each pair a measured-bad pos41 residue with V54.
Distant-diversity probes ~0: WSFW 0.0143, LTKP 0.0018. Both near the assay floor.
Surrogate diagnostics (n=72): CV RMSE 0.551, Spearman 0.573. Noise floor ~ +/-0.55 makes the 2.8315 vs 2.2863 gap not significant. INGA and INGV are each single unreplicated measurements.

strategy_implications.rationale: Round 4 is terminal, so every assay is a potential final pick; 2 assays (INGA + INGV/IKGA) discriminate H-08 and re-rank the plateau before spending on doubles.

Only ING*-family constructs can plausibly exceed 2.8315: plateau doubles (H-04) and unexplored biologically-plausible singles - pos54 Y/F/I/M (H-02), pos39 W/F (H-06), pos41 F/I/M (H-05). Allocate ~60-70% of budget here.
In a final round, surrogate uncertainty has no downstream use unless the monitored candidate could itself win. Restrict to 2-4 near-plateau extremes and deprioritize below the beat-candidates.
WSFW/LTKP ~0 make distant signal unlikely, but one guard assay hedges surrogate blind spots at trivial cost; expect ~0 (H-07).
pos41 E/R/Q/V/T and pos54 K/R/P/D are measured-dead (<0.22); do not spend final assays on their combinations.
If INGA replicates < 2.0, re-rank around IKGA/IVGA/INGV as parents instead of INGA; keep 3-4 assays liquid until the replicate result returns.

uncertainties: Noise floor +/-0.55 (CV RMSE): all fitness gaps below ~0.7 are uninterpretable
Zero measured double mutants: additivity/epistasis reasoning rests on noisy singles and surrogate extrapolation (Spearman 0.573) to Hamming-2+
pos39 dimension completely unprobed on ING*; pos54 aromatics (incl. WT Y54) unprobed
Only 2 distant probes (both ~0): single-peak assumption consistent but not established
Published GB1 landscape maxima exceed the current best, so 2.8315 is not assumed to be the global optimum
